sources.title: harshvardhankulkarni/ai-model-comparison - GitHub
sources.snippet: Model data is defined as a DataFrame with benchmark scores, cost, speed, and context window. A composite benchmark score is calculated using weighted averages. Models are grouped into performance tiers based on composite scores. Use case recommendations are generated based on model strengths. Four visualizations compare models across dimensions.
